title: Kromrif
wikitext: {{Velious Era}} [[File:Npc_a_frost_giant.png|right]]{{Factionpage| | description = The frost giants. Allied with the [[Kromzek]] and enemies of the [[Coldain]]. Most Kromrif are considered the lower class of the society of giants on Velious, and live either in their city of [[Kael Drakkel]] with the storm giants or venture out into the [[Eastern Wastes]] and [[Great Divide]] in search of [[Coldain]] enemies. They tend to sport rugged beards and wear leather and scale armor. Like the [[Coldain]], they have domesticated the native dire wolves of [[Velious]] to assist them in battle and track enemies and game.
